categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Bioperfectus Technologies Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of in vitro diagnostic (IVD) reagents and supporting diagnostic instruments. The company operates an integrated business model of 'reagents + instruments + services,' covering infectious disease detection, maternal and child health, tumor diagnosis, nutrition management, and chronic disease management. It also extends into key raw materials production and third-party testing services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary core technology platforms including nucleic acid detection, next-generation sequencing (NGS), point-of-care testing (POCT), mass spectrometry, and automation control and detection platforms. It applies advanced molecular biology techniques such as multiplex fluorescent quantitative PCR, digital PCR, and high-throughput sequencing. Production methods emphasize automation, intelligent integration of instruments and reagents, and quality control systems to ensure high sensitivity, specificity, and throughput.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include disease control centers, hospitals, third-party testing institutions, physical examination centers, and research units across China and internationally. The company serves markets in infectious disease prevention and control, clinical diagnostics, large-scale population screening, maternal and child health management, and tumor screening. It is a major supplier to over 300 municipal CDCs in China and participates in national cancer screening programs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Taizhou, Jiangsu Province. It has established subsidiaries and branches in Hong Kong, the United States, the United Kingdom, Indonesia, and other regions. Its products are sold in over 100 countries and regions globally, with increasing overseas revenue and active participation in international exhibitions and markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Bioperfectus operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the IVD supply chain, focusing on the development and manufacturing of diagnostic reagents and instruments. It also invests in upstream raw material development to ensure supply security and reduce external dependencies, thus covering a broad vertical integration from raw materials to finished diagnostic solutions and services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with sustained high R&D investment (~29% of revenue). Strategic R&D directions include enhancing NGS applications, advancing POCT technologies, integrating mass spectrometry for expanded diagnostic capabilities, and leveraging AI and big data for precision diagnostics. It focuses on developing new diagnostic biomarkers, instrument-reagent integration, and expanding international market competitiveness through collaborations and regulatory approvals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of in vitro diagnostic reagents, diagnostic instruments, and related testing services. The company employs a combined direct sales and distribution model, with revenues recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance. It also receives government subsidies and investment income, but product sales constitute the main revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic supplier in molecular diagnostics and infectious disease testing, holding a strong position in nucleic acid detection products for disease control centers. It competes in a rapidly growing and increasingly competitive IVD market, leveraging proprietary technology platforms and integrated solutions to maintain competitive advantages. It is recognized for its contributions to national screening programs and public health emergencies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 350 million, a 13.29% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 2 million, significantly reduced compared to prior years. The company maintains substantial assets (~RMB 3.74 billion) and equity (~RMB 3.25 billion). It has demonstrated improved cash flow from operations and continues to invest heavily in R&D, indicating a focus on sustainable growth despite short-term profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Bioperfectus emphasizes its integrated 'reagents + instruments + services' model, proprietary core technologies, and comprehensive diagnostic solutions tailored to infectious diseases, maternal-child health, and oncology. Its products feature high sensitivity, specificity, automation, and intelligent data analysis capabilities. The company differentiates itself through continuous innovation, extensive product registrations, strong clinical validation, and a broad international presence, aiming to provide precise, efficient, and accessible diagnostic services.
